blind.description: A decorative wall corbel or shelf bracket in a classical/fantasy style. It consists of a flat horizontal top ledge with gold-trimmed edges and corner caps, supported by a vertical wall plate and an ornate curved bracket scroll. Nestled in the angle beneath the shelf is a sculpted golden sun featuring a serene human face surrounded by radiating pointed rays. Materials appear to be polished ivory or cream marble/stone with gilded gold accents.
blind.from_above: An elongated rectangular stone ledge with golden borders and corner caps, with the gold backplate edge visible at one end and pointed sun rays protruding slightly from underneath along the sides.
blind.height_vs_figure: About one-third as tall as the figure (around 1.8 to 2 feet tall) and roughly 1.5 feet wide horizontally.
